en.answer: When the effect of <<11894>> resolves, even if the targeted Spell/Trap Card is now face-up, it is destroyed normally.
en.question: If the effect of <<11894>> that destroys a Spell/Trap Card is activated, but the targeted Spell/Trap Card is chained so that it becomes face-up, will it be destroyed?
